oneLiner: Split shared trip expenses effortlessly—no spreadsheet required.
problem: Travelers struggle to track who paid for what during group trips, leading to awkward math, forgotten expenses, and delayed repayments.
targetUser: Friend groups, couples, and colleagues taking shared trips who want a simple, transparent way to settle costs without manual spreadsheets.
coreFlow: Create a trip and invite members via link
Log an expense: payer, amount, and who it's split between
View real-time balances showing who owes whom
Settle up with one-click payment links or mark as paid
Review trip summary and export final report

screens.name: Trip Dashboard
screens.purpose: See all trip members, total spent, and current balances at a glance.

screens.name: Add Expense
screens.purpose: Quickly record a new shared cost with payer, amount, and split details.

screens.name: Balances
screens.purpose: Show simplified debts and suggested settlements between members.

screens.name: Activity Feed
screens.purpose: Browse chronological list of all expenses with filters and edit options.

screens.name: Settle Up
screens.purpose: Mark debts as paid and generate payment links or reminders.

outOfScope: Direct bank account integration or automatic payments
Real-time currency conversion for international trips
